messages:
maya: Quick async standup — heads up on GPU pools this morning.

maya: AMS pool at ~78% util, us-west(a) at ~92% with bursty short jobs. I'm planning to add 4 p4d nodes to us-west-staging to drain queues. Holding off on prod scale until we hear about quotas. @tariq @olga

tariq: ok for staging, go ahead. For prod we should confirm reserved_capacity thresholds; last time we hit 95% we saw latency spikes.

lucas: saw 3 OOM errors on p4d-2 yesterday, might be the new kernel. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T20:32:01Z oom_killer invoked: task=python3 pid=8432 rss=124GB
```
Can we pin the model on that rollout?

jen: I rolled back the microkernel in prod@22:10 — perf looks stable. Was monitoring for 30m, no regressions. :thumbsup:

olga: quota request for +6 p4d in us-west submitted (PR-987). GCP says review by EOD. link: https://infra.internal/pr/987

infra-bot: [capacity-report] us-west: 92% used (132/144), AMS: 78% (56/72), eu-central: 42% (30/72) — pending requests: 1 (6 GPUs)

maya: Thanks — I'll provision the 4 in staging and queue the prod change behind olga's quota approval. If we see >90% in prod again, fallback to smaller batch sizes and enable prefix caching. Will update this thread when nodes are up.
